title: Print Footer Visibility Fix
description: Fix print LaTeX page geometry so footer chrome bar is fully on-page and its outer spacing/positioning mirrors the header. Use includehead/includefoot geometry with shared top/bottom gap token.
summary: Fixed print page geometry so header and footer chrome reserve space correctly. Exposed \semio@page@margin per document type in semio.cls. Replaced asymmetric geometry in semio-window.sty with one includehead/includefoot call using shared \semio@chrome@page@gap for top and bottom. Removed dead \addtolength{\topmargin} and lone \geometry{bottom=...}. All 12 template PDFs build; report textheight shrinks from 771.7pt to 720.5pt with symmetric T=B=28.6pt; footer bar and page number now visible on body pages.
